title: InteroperabilityCertificationProfile
description: The public, versioned yardstick an implementation is certified against (ADR-032). Pins the conformance level, capabilities and the required schemas/contracts/invariants/endpoints, the identity/signature/trust requirements, and the validity window. Immutable once published (a change is a new profile_version). Derived only from L1 protocol contracts; introduces no operator-specific criteria (ADR-001).
_authority: ADR-032 (interoperability certification); this schema and the conformance/ suites define the profile. engines/banza-certification implements it and does not define it.

validity_days.description: Validity window of the resulting certificate; never open-ended (ADR-032).

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
